event.title: Highest temperature in LA on Feb 12, 2025?

markets.rules_primary: If the highest temperature recorded in Los Angeles Airport, CA for February 12, 2025 as reported by the National Weather Service's Daily Climate Report, is less than 52°, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Please be advised to check to see what temperatures have occurred previously in the day. While the market resolves based on the finalized report from the NWS, traders should use other data sources--including other preliminary NWS reporting--to inform their trades.
 
The Last Trading Time will be 11:59 PM PT on February 12, 2025 regardless of any data releases or events occurring. Expiration will occur on the sooner of the first 7:00 or 8:00
AM ET following the release of the data for February 12, 2025, or one week after February 12, 2025.
